fields.title: Honduras tender record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). 'list' mode records use the register's own list-grid fields (camelCase); 'detail' mode records (and 'list' mode with fetchDetail on) also carry the register's own Spanish detail-page labels verbatim, plus a few split-out conveniences (contactoEmail, and the productos/documentos/participantes/adjudicadoA line-item arrays).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The filters used to produce this record ('list' mode) or the detail URL fetched ('detail' mode).

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-aspnet-gridview (a list-search result row), S1-aspnet-detail (a fetched detail page), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (search matched nothing), blocked_or_transient (network/server issue after retries).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_detailError.title: Detail fetch error
_detailError.description: Present only on a 'list' mode record with fetchDetail=true, when the detail-page fetch for this specific tender failed -- the list-grid fields are still present.

expediente.title: Record number
expediente.description: The tender's official record/file number ("Expediente"), exactly as shown on the register.

entidad.title: Institution
entidad.description: The government institution running this procurement.

unidadCompra.title: Purchasing unit
unidadCompra.description: The specific department/unit within the institution handling this process.

objetoCompra.title: Object of purchase
objetoCompra.description: Short description of what is being procured, as shown on the results list (may be truncated with '...' -- fetch the detail page for the full text).

etapa.title: Stage
etapa.description: Current process stage, e.g. "Elaboración" (in preparation), "Recepción de Ofertas" (receiving offers), "Adjudicado" (awarded), "Fracasados" (failed).

modalidad.title: Modality
modalidad.description: Procurement modality, e.g. "Licitación pública nacional", "Compra Menor".

fechaInicio.title: Start date
fechaInicio.description: Process start/publication date as shown on the register (dd/mm/yyyy).

fechaCierre.title: Closing date
fechaCierre.description: Offer/bid closing date as shown on the register (dd/mm/yyyy).

detailUrl.title: Detail page URL
detailUrl.description: Link to the full ProcesoHistorico.aspx detail page for this tender -- feed this into 'detail' mode's 'url'/'urls' input for full information.

Expediente.title: Record number (detail)
Expediente.description: Detail-page label/value table field, present on 'detail' mode records (and 'list' mode with fetchDetail=true).

Entidad.title: Institution (detail)
Entidad.description: Full institution name, from the detail page.

Objeto.title: Object of purchase (detail)
Objeto.description: Untruncated object-of-purchase text from the detail page.

Fecha de Inicio.title: Start date/time (detail)
Fecha de Inicio.description: Includes time of day, e.g. "22/12/2026 02:16:00 p.m.".

Fuente.title: Funding source (detail)
Fuente.description: e.g. "Entidad" (institution's own funds), "Banco Mundial", "BID", or a specific donor country.

Valor Pliegos.title: Bidding-document fee (detail)
Valor Pliegos.description: Document fee amount, currency prefix "Lps." (Honduran lempiras).

Contacto.title: Contact (detail, combined text)
Contacto.description: Contact person's name and phone number as one combined text field, exactly as the register displays them (the email is split out separately as contactoEmail).

contactoEmail.title: Contact email
contactoEmail.description: The buyer contact's email address, parsed out of the detail page's mailto link.

productos.title: Line items
productos.description: "Productos y/o Servicios Solicitados" tab -- one entry per requested item/service, with UNSPSC code, Spanish description, full specification text, and requested quantity. Empty array if the tender has none listed yet.

documentos.title: Documents
documentos.description: "Documentos" tab -- attached document names/files. Empty array if none are attached yet.

participantes.title: Bidders
participantes.description: "Participantes" tab -- bidders who submitted offers. Empty array until offers have been received.

adjudicadoA.title: Award
adjudicadoA.description: "Adjudicado a" tab -- award details (winning supplier, price) once the process has concluded. Empty array until awarded.
